We do not require you to occupy a business office for the Franchised Business until 6 months after the Business Start Date. We assume that you move into your business office after the initial period ends and before the 6-month deadline. We therefore exclude rent and related expenses attributable to the business office (e.g., lease security deposit, furnishings, shelving, lighting, and other improvements typical for a “flex” work space that includes storage). We impose no minimum size requirements.

As noted earlier, the Additional Funds category does not include an allowance for expenses attributable to locating, building-out or operating from approved commercial business premises in the Territory or payment of the Site Pre-Inspection Fee since we do not require that you move into approved business premises during the initial period, although you may choose to do so.

You incur no expenses to buy or lease a vehicle specifically to operate the Franchised Business. You use a vehicle that you already own or lease for any local travel associated with operating the Franchised Business and your employees use their own vehicles to travel to and from an Account’s place of business. You own a computer with an operating system meeting our minimum requirements that we describe in Item 11 and incur no incremental expenses to lease or purchase computer hardware specifically attributable to the iNX franchise.
The high estimate assumes that you do and reflects that a member of our management team spends 10 hours of time working with you during the interview and evaluation process.

The Interview and Testing Services Support Fee is an hourly fee, as we explain in Items 5 and 6. There is no minimum or maximum amount of time that we will spend; this is a service that we offer to you at your request.
None of the expenses shown in the Item 7 table is normally refundable.
